purpose: Machine-readable candidate ownership map. Human owners must validate the entries relevant to an active slice against code and operations before implementation.

responsibilities.title: Referral state persistence and optimistic mutation
invariants: Same-section stale writes are rejected.
Retry outcomes preserve the characterized per-command replay or conflict contract.
Material PostgreSQL mutation and its audit event commit or roll back together.
forbiddenParallelOwners: API routes implementing referral persistence policy
React components writing referral storage directly

responsibilities.title: Assessment lifecycle, provenance, and persistence
invariants: A signed assessment is immutable except through append-only addenda.
Field evidence and reviewer attribution survive persistence.
Assessment-owned workflow synchronization preserves its characterized transaction behavior.

responsibilities.title: Referral workflow transitions, terminal decisions, and EHR handoff
invariants: Stages cannot be skipped and terminal decisions cannot silently reopen.
Only authorized actors can recommend, decide, assign, or record a handoff.
Projections never become a second canonical writer.
forbiddenParallelOwners: Assessment or UI modules becoming canonical workflow writers

responsibilities.title: Identity, request integrity, and resource-level authorization
invariants: Authentication never substitutes for resource authorization.
Every mutation validates identity, request integrity, role, and resource scope.
A denied command creates no protected side effect.
forbiddenParallelOwners: Route-local role strings without canonical policy
Worker credentials accepted at browser boundaries

responsibilities.title: Transaction-local audit attribution and mutation retry semantics
invariants: Audit policy may be shared but protected writes remain transaction-local.
Replay-idempotent, conflict-safe, and deliberately non-retryable commands are not conflated.
A duplicate execution never applies a material mutation twice.
forbiddenParallelOwners: Asynchronous audit as the sole record of a protected mutation
A global audit repository that breaks transaction coupling

responsibilities.title: Resident identity candidate generation and explicit reviewed linking
invariants: Names are display data and never sufficient identity keys.
Ambiguous candidates require explicit human review.
Rejected, stale, or unauthorized link commands create no canonical link.

responsibilities.title: Immutable packet ingestion, extraction provenance, and worker state
invariants: Original source bytes remain immutable and digest verified.
Every accepted value retains document, page, location, confidence, and review history.
Workers cannot write canonical referral or assessment state directly.
forbiddenParallelOwners: Provider output treated as canonical without validation and review

responsibilities.title: Referral and assessment UI draft, autosave, remount, and conflict state
invariants: Remount, navigation, and concurrent saves do not silently discard accepted user work.
Conflict resolution never overwrites a newer server version without explicit intent.
Focus, keyboard, presence, upload, and extraction-review behavior remain stable.
forbiddenParallelOwners: Multiple unsynchronized client sources of truth
Presentation components performing server persistence directly

responsibilities.title: Behavior assertion ownership and test-effectiveness preservation
invariants: User-visible assertions remain visible and traceable to journeys.
Helpers do not hide weakened expectations or cleanup semantics.
Source-string checks never substitute for runtime behavior evidence.
forbiddenParallelOwners: Duplicate helper frameworks with different cleanup semantics
